data.title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer - Voice AI & Integrations
data.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • CRM, EMR/EHR, and Business-System Integrations: Design, build, and maintain integrations with legal practice-management platforms, medical systems, accounting platforms, calendars, and other industry tools.
  • Reliable Appointment Scheduling: Own availability checks, booking, rescheduling, cancellations, confirmations, and synchronization across systems. Resolve time-zone issues, duplicate bookings, scheduling conflicts, and failed updates.
  • Voice AI Workflows: Connect Twilio and OpenAI conversations to dependable backend actions, including intake, contact creation, scheduling, call transfers, and follow-up.
  • Integration Architecture: Build reusable connectors with secure authentication, consistent data mapping, background processing, retries, duplicate prevention, monitoring, and recovery from failures.
  • Full-Stack Development: Deliver changes across the frontend, backend, databases, and third-party services. Investigate production problems and implement fixes directly.
  • Infrastructure and Reliability: Improve cloud infrastructure, deployments, CI/CD, observability, performance, security, and operating costs.
  • Technical Leadership: Work closely with the CTO to translate priorities into practical technical plans. Guide developers, review code, remove blockers, and stay accountable through testing, deployment, and customer use.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Typically 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of production SaaS systems.
  • Strong TypeScript/JavaScript skills, substantial backend experience, and proficiency in Python.
  • Experience building frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and relational database systems.
  • Proven experience shipping and maintaining multiple production integrations using REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and asynchronous processing.
  • Strong understanding of two-way synchronization, rate limits, token refresh, partial failures, reconciliation, and data consistency.
  • Experience with scheduling or transactional workflows where incorrect or duplicate actions have real consequences.
  • Practical cloud infrastructure, containerization, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and incident-response experience.
  • Ability to understand an existing codebase quickly, identify root causes, and deliver focused improvements.
  • Clear communication, sound technical judgment, and experience leading other engineers while remaining an active individual contributor.

Nice-to-Have

  • Twilio voice, real-time audio streaming, OpenAI APIs, and AI tool/function calling.
  • Google Calendar, Microsoft Graph, and scheduling-platform integrations.
  • Legal platforms such as Clio, MyCase, PracticePanther, or Lawmatics.
  • Healthcare integrations such as athenahealth or Office Ally, including familiarity with FHIR/HL7 where applicable.
  • Experience engineering systems that handle sensitive patient or client information, including tenant isolation, access controls, audit trails, and secure credential storage.
  • Experience navigating vendor approval processes, restricted APIs, sandbox access, and integration partnerships.


System and Work Setup Requirements:

  • A stable and high-speed internet connection preferably 25 MBPS or higher with backup in cases of power interruption or service provider issues.
  • Own PC/laptop with 8GB RAM, and a processor of Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 / 2013 Mac equivalent or higher; Windows 10 or above / Catalina 10.15 or newer; with up-to-date web browsers, and security software, 500GB/128 SSD storage
  • Headset/earphone with noise cancellation and webcam at 720p or higher resolution
  • A designated, quiet, and well-organized workspace free from distractions to facilitate focused work

Benefits

  • Permanent remote work setup
  • Competitive starting rate paid in USD
  • Internet Allowance
  • HMO insurance (PH)
  • Paid US holidays
  • Paid Vacation and Sick Leaves

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/lead-full-stack-engineer-voice-ai-integrations-berry-virtual-medvirtual-ai-virtual

data.title: Senior SAP BTP Consultant
data.description:
The project focuses on the development and extension of a custom cloud-based solution built on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), supporting business processes related to quality management, product release and certification. The solution is designed to integrate data from multiple source systems, consolidate relevant business and quality information, and provide a centralized platform to support and streamline release and certification processes across the enterprise landscape.

The project is primarily focused on custom application development, system integration, and technical delivery, rather than standard SAP maintenance or support activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop cloud extensions and applications on SAP BTP, including CAP-based applications.
  • Build scalable, high-quality solutions integrated with SAP S/4HANA and other enterprise systems.
  • Develop and enhance SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 front-end solutions.
  • Develop APIs and integration services using technologies such as OData and REST.
  • Contribute to the development and extension of the solution.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Estimate development effort and ensure solution quality and adherence to engineering best practices.
  • Participate in technical design and architecture decisions.
  • Represent the technical team in discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Coordinate development activities and support technical decisions within the team.
  • Perform code reviews and contribute to troubleshooting complex technical issues.
  • Support technical roadmaps, continuous improvement, and innovation initiatives.
  • Share knowledge and, where applicable, mentor less experienced developers.
  • Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience in projects based on SAP Business Technology Platform.
  • Practical proficiency in at least 3 of the following technologies: SAPUI5 / Fiori; SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP / CAPM); SAP Cloud SDK for JavaScript; SAP Cloud Foundry; SAP BTP Services.
  • Very good knowledge of JavaScript; TypeScript experience is an advantage.
  • Experience designing and developing cloud applications and extensions on SAP BTP.
  • Understanding API-based integrations, ideally including REST / OData.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with complex technical requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within an international, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience integrating BTP applications with SAP S/4HANA

Nice to have

  • SAP Integration Suite / CPI.
  • SAP HANA.
  • SAP Event Mesh / API Management.
  • SAP Build / SAP Build Process Automation.
  • Node.js or Java.
  • Experience with Release & Certification or similar business processes.
  • Experience in pharma, healthcare or another regulated environment.
  • SAP BTP certification.

Benefits

  • Full access to foreign language learning platform
  • Personalized access to tech learning platforms
  • Tailored workshops and trainings to sustain your growth
  • Medical insurance
  • Meal tickets
  • Monthly budget to allocate on flexible benefit platform
  • Access to 7 Card services
  • Wellbeing activities and gatherings

remote, 10 months project

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (PCS979)
data.description:
We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers of a fast-growing AI app builder for business users, helping them get unstuck, fix their apps, and build with confidence. The platform lets business owners describe the software they need in plain language and get a working product. Those customers are not technical, so when the platform's AI agent falls short, they need an engineer who can step in and finish the job.

Please read this part carefully: this is a customer-facing technical support role. It is not a feature development role, and you will not be building the product roadmap. You will spend your days working directly with customers, debugging their apps, advising on architecture and integrations, and explaining the answer in plain language. If you are a software developer who enjoys working directly with customers and solving their real problems, and you are comfortable with this being a support role, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires working US Pacific Time (PST) business hours
  • Work on a modern stack with AI at the core of the product
  • Direct exposure to a wide range of real customer problems, industries, and architectures

What You'll Work On

Customer Problem Solving

  • Work directly with customers to resolve technical issues in their apps, including bugs, authentication, databases, payments, and integrations
  • Debug production issues using logs, traces, repros, and minimal test cases
  • Advise customers on architecture and next steps, and help them choose the right approach
  • Explain problems and fixes in clear, simple language that a non-technical business owner can follow

Feeding Back to the Product

  • Spot patterns across customer issues and share them with the engineering team so root causes get fixed
  • Write clear bug reports and reproductions for the product team
  • Help keep documentation and known-issue notes accurate and current

Support Workflow

  • Work through a steady queue of customer issues and keep every case moving until it is resolved
  • Build small tools and automations to speed up your own workflow
  • Escalate complex issues to the right engineer with a clear summary

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Strong TypeScript and React skills
  • Experience working directly with clients, ideally US clients, including communicating technical issues clearly
  • Solid web app fundamentals, including HTTP, APIs, authentication, and databases
  • Ability to read, debug, and fix production code and reason about how a system is failing
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Patience and empathy when working with non-technical customers
  • Comfort with this being a support role, and a genuine interest in solving customer problems directly
  • Available to work full-time on US Pacific Time (PST) business hours

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in technical support, customer engineering, or solutions engineering
  • Experience with Postgres, Redis, Hono, Drizzle ORM, or Cloudflare and AWS
  • Experience building with AI SDKs and LLM-based applications
  • Experience building automations or internal tools to scale support
  • Experience working in a high-volume customer queue

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A GitHub link or example of work if you have one
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your engineering and client-facing experience, confirming that you are comfortable with this being a support role, and walking through a technical problem you solved for a client

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are an engineer who likes solving real problems for real customers and wants to be the person who gets them unstuck, this role gives you the variety and the direct impact to do your best work.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/forward-deployed-engineer-pcs979-hire-overseas

data.title: KI-Entwickler LLM / RAG / Agenten – Python oder TypeScript (m/w/d)
data.description:
Du baust KI-Anwendungen, die beim Kunden im Regelbetrieb laufen: Dialogsysteme, semantische Suche, RAG-Pipelines, Agenten mit Werkzeuganbindung. Kein Prototyp für die Schublade.

Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, Büros in Stuttgart und München. Aus hunderten Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstandskunden wissen wir, wie man Software baut, die im Ernstfall trägt. Seit einer Weile verschiebt sich unser Schwerpunkt Richtung KI: LLM-Anwendungen, RAG, Agenten-Systeme, die beim Kunden produktiv gehen.

Worum es geht

Unsere Kunden sind die Deutsche Bahn und IT-Dienstleister im öffentlichen Sektor, ein reguliertes Umfeld mit hohen Ansprüchen an Datenschutz, EU AI Act und Betriebssicherheit. Dort baust du KI-Lösungen in bestehende Fachanwendungen ein. Projektsprache ist Deutsch. Der Alltag läuft remote-first, Kundentermine meist in Frankfurt am Main.

Unsere Kunden stellen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten besetzt. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Aufgaben

  • Sprachmodelle in Fachanwendungen integrieren: RAG mit Retrieval und Reranking, Tool-Calling, MCP-Server, Multi-Agent-Abläufe

  • Evaluierung aufbauen: Antwortqualität messen, Halluzinationen eingrenzen, Kosten und Token-Verbrauch im Griff behalten

  • Modelle auswählen und wechselbar halten (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, offene Modelle), Governance und Datenschutz mitdenken

  • Betrieb: Container, CI/CD, Monitoring, Alerting

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Fachbereich, Architektur und Betrieb des Kunden

Das musst du mitbringen

Jeder Punkt muss im Lebenslauf nachweisbar sein.

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Softwareentwicklung in Python oder TypeScript, nach Ausbildung oder Studium

  • Mindestens eine LLM-Anwendung, die bei einem Kunden oder Arbeitgeber produktiv lief (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agenten), mit deinem Anteil daran

  • Docker, CI/CD und Git aus dem Projektalltag

  • Deutsch mindestens C1 in Wort und Schrift

Das bringst du idealerweise mit

Kein Muss, aber je mehr davon, desto besser:

  • Kubernetes oder OpenShift, Helm

  • MLOps-Werkzeuge (MLflow, Kubeflow, Model Serving) und klassisches ML im Produktivbetrieb

  • Vektordatenbanken, Embedding-Modelle, Reranker

  • Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock oder Vertex AI

  • EU AI Act, ISO 27001, Barrierefreiheit

  • Erfahrung bei Bahn, Behörden oder Sozialversicherung

  • Prometheus und Grafana, ArgoCD, SAFe

Benefits

  • Echte Produktivprojekte. KI, die beim Kunden in Betrieb geht. Kein Innovation-Lab, keine Folien.

  • Remote-first in der DACH-Region. Gelegentlich vor Ort, ansonsten arbeitest du von dort, wo du gut arbeitest.

  • Internes Upskilling. Wir investieren in deine KI-Skills.

  • MacBook

  • Flache Hierarchien. Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner.

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/ki-entwickler-llm-rag-agenten-python-oder-typescript-mwd-rockstardevelopers-gmbh

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world’s leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We’re an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

Our Values

Customers

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

Action

We make ‘thoughtfully fast’ decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

Team Spirit

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

Innovation

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

Excellence

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

About the Role

The Lead Software Engineer is a critical role responsible for providing technical leadership within a domain-aligned cohort, guiding engineers in delivering quality, scalable SaaS products. You will leverage AI tools and co-worker agents such as Claude Code to specify, implement, validate, deploy, and support the most complex features end-to-end, focusing your expertise on architectural judgment, specification quality, and mentorship.

This position partners closely with the Engineering Manager on cohort health and delivery, interfaces with Product Managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications, and plays a key role in building the cohort’s collective expertise. You’ll drive AI-assisted development practices and standards, mentor engineers across the cohort, and advise on tools and technologies that evolve our development organization.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership & Specification

  • Provide technical leadership within the cohort, guiding engineers in spec-driven, AI-assisted development
    • Own specification quality for the most complex features, ensuring specs are comprehensive, unambiguous, and address all edge cases and non-functional requirements
    • Collaborate with the Product Manager and stakeholders to translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications, and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Other duties as assigned.

AI-Assisted Implementation & Quality

  • Lead AI-assisted implementation for complex features, using AI coding tools such as Claude Code to generate implementations from specifications
    • Review AI-generated code and peer contributions for correctness, security, performance, and architectural alignment
    • Validate AI-generated tests and ensure comprehensive test coverage for complex scenarios
    • Drive AI workflow standards and best practices across your cohort, advise on tools and technologies to evolve our development organization, and share learnings with other cohorts

Software Design, Delivery & Mentorship

  • Create software designs that consider both current and future requirements with a DevOps mindset that will scale as our volumes increase
    • Design and implement REST APIs following established patterns, and support and maintain both UI and backend services within your cohort’s domain
    • Lead technical decisions and own domain expertise within your cohort
    • Mentor engineers across the cohort on effective AI tool usage, spec writing techniques, and code review practices

What You’ll Bring

Required Skills:

  • 7+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with at least 2 years designing and implementing enterprise SaaS systems
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or equivalent experience), along with a firm understanding of data structures and scalable software design
    • Experience coding enterprise systems at scale, with mastery of C#, C++, PHP, Java, Node.js or a similar high-level language
    • Proficiency in HTML5, CSS/Sass, Angular, React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and other web technologies, with a strong ability to design and implement REST APIs
    • Strong understanding of SQL and relational databases (such as SQL Server or MySQL), and proficiency in multiple persistence technologies such as NoSQL and indexed files
    • Demonstrated experience working with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar), including strong code review skills to validate correctness and identify issues in AI-generated and human-written code
    • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of mentoring engineers and translating business requirements into technical specifications alongside Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and cross-functional teams
    • Well-honed skills in source control management using Git or similar, and experience with AWS, Azure, or a similar cloud platform

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with spec-driven, agentic AI workflows where engineers delegate autonomous tasks to AI tools and provide guidance and oversight
    • Experience establishing AI development practices or standards across teams
    • Understanding of testable application design principles
    • Track record of advising on tools and technologies that improved team productivity

The expected base salary range for this position is $157,000 - $208,000 annually.

Compensation may vary depending on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, competencies, and geographic location. Some roles may qualify for extra incentives like equity, commissions, or other variable performance-related bonuses. Further details will be provided by our Talent Acquisition team during the interview process.

What You’ll Get

At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. We’re building something special and we want you to feel supported while doing it.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
At Quest Analytics®, we build technology that helps health plans navigate some of the most complex challenges in healthcare. We’re searching for a Software Engineer to help us build and scale our platform.

You’ll own the features you build, from first requirements conversation through deployment, working alongside product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers. Your input on design and architecture will carry real weight, and the decisions you help make will shape our current offerings, and new product lines as we grow.

Our engineering teams value high-quality code, open collaboration, and creative problem solving. We review each other’s work with constructive feedback, communicate early about blockers and risks, and take ownership of our results. We also embrace new technology, including AI-powered tools, to improve both the quality and the speed of what we deliver, and you’ll have a hand in shaping how our teams use them.

What you'll do

  • Take part in the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through implementation, testing, and deployment.

  • Partner with product managers, designers, architects, and DevOps engineers to turn requirements into working software.

  • Own your project timelines and deliverables, flag blockers and risks early so your team can help.

  • Contribute to the design and architecture of new and existing products and features.

  • Write clean, efficient, maintainable code built for performance and scalability.

  • Give constructive feedback in code reviews and hold your work to team coding standards.

  • Use AI-powered tools in your daily work to improve the quality and speed of development and help shape how the team adopts them.

  • Make day-to-day technical decisions within established patterns, and bring larger choices, like major frameworks or design patterns, to your manager.

  • Handle confidential information with care, especially protected health information (PHI), and follow Quest Analytics HIPAA Privacy and Security Practices.

  • Join training and mentoring programs, as a learner or as a guide.

What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Three to five years of backend development with Microsoft’s .NET Framework and C# at a commercial SaaS company, ideally working with large data sets.

  • Proficiency in SQL Server and in designing, building, and consuming REST APIs.

  • Snowflake, Databricks, or general data platform experience for large data processing.

  • Experience building on Azure cloud services, including Azure Functions, Event Grid, and Service Bus, plus familiarity with Blob Storage or AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SNS, or SQS.

  • Experience with React or a comparable modern JavaScript framework for front-end work.

  • Familiarity with unit testing (XUnit preferred) and SOLID principles.

  • Source control experience with Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, and a collaborative, team-oriented approach to your work.

  • Experience multiplying your output with AI development tools.

Compensation

Additional Information

About Quest Analytics

For more than 20 years, we’ve been improving provider network management one groundbreaking innovation at a time. 90% of America’s health plans use our tools, including the eight largest in the nation. Achieve your personal quest to build a great career here.

What you’ll appreciate:

•Workplace flexibility – you choose between remote, hybrid or in-office

•Affordable employee medical, dental and vision plans with low employee cost

•401k Matching

•Wellness benefits

•Competitive salary and success sharing bonus

•Flexible vacation, plus sick time and holidays

•An entrepreneurial culture that won’t limit you to a job description

•Being listened to, valued, appreciated -- and having your contributions rewarded

•Enjoying your work each day with a great group of people

Apply TODAY!

careers.questanalytics.com

Next Steps
After you apply, you will receive an email confirming receipt of your application. If your background and experience align with our needs, a member of the Quest Analytics Talent Acquisition team will contact you regarding next steps in the process. Candidates will receive communication throughout the interview process regarding their status and progression.

Interview Process
The interview process may vary by role but typically includes:

  • Recruiter Video Interview
  • Video Interview with the Hiring Manager
  • Team and/or Panel Interview(s)
  • Role-Specific Assessment, Presentation, or Case Study (if applicable)
  • Professional Reference Checks via Skill Survey
  • Final Interview with Executive Leadership

Video Camera Usage Policy
Quest Analytics is a remote-first organization that values collaboration, communication, and engagement. To support a connected and productive work environment, candidates are expected to participate in all virtual interviews with their cameras enabled.
Video participation helps create a more interactive interview experience, allows for stronger communication and relationship-building, and supports our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process. Camera usage also serves as an important safeguard against fraudulent applicants, identity misrepresentation, unauthorized participation, and other security risks that have become increasingly common in remote hiring environments.
Candidates who are unable or unwilling to participate on camera during the interview process may not be considered for employment.

Relocation Requirement
While many positions at Quest Analytics are remote, employees are expected to reside in and perform work from the location disclosed during the hiring process. Any relocation must be communicated to and approved by Quest Analytics in advance.
This policy helps ensure compliance with employment and tax regulations, protects company and client data, and reduces risks associated with unauthorized work arrangements and employment misrepresentation.

AI Tools

As part of our hiring process, Quest Analytics may use AI-assisted tools to help screen applications and support interview documentation, including resume-matching software and AI-generated interview summaries. These tools inform but do not replace human judgment; all hiring decisions are made by Quest Analytics team members. If you have questions about our use of AI in hiring, please contact recruiting@questanalytics.com.

**Visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

Preferred work locations are within one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin, or Wyoming.

Quest Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to all people without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation or gender identity or expression or any other legally protected category. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discriminations or harassment.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

Persons with disabilities who anticipate needing accommodations for any part of the application process may contact, in confidence hr@questanalytics.com

NOTE: Staffing agencies, headhunters, recruiters, and/or placement agencies, please do not contact our hiring managers directly. We are not currently working with additional outside agencies at this time.

Any job posting displayed on websites other than questanalytics.com or jobs.lever.co/questanalytics/ may be out of date, inaccurate and unavailable

RECRUITMENT FRAUD ALERT

We urge you not to disclose any personal or financial information to them. We use only our official website (https://questanalytics.com), email domain (@questanalytics.com), and verified social media accounts to communicate with candidates. data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
data.description:
Headquarters: Americas Remote

Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We're looking for a staff engineer to set technical direction for the systems that move billions of messages a day. This isn't a role about shipping more, faster. It's about deciding what gets built, where the architecture needs to go next, and raising the ceiling for the engineers around you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership at company scale

You take on the problems nobody has claimed yet — the ones that span squads, have no obvious owner, and would quietly cost us a year if left alone. You either solve them or get leadership aligned to.

Engineers with product taste

You think like a user, not just an engineer. You connect architectural decisions to what customers actually experience, and you can explain that connection to people who don't write Go.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"

You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

Force multiplication

Your best quarter isn't measured by what you shipped. It's measured by what the department can now do that it couldn't before.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the technical direction of our distributed messaging systems in Go — making the high-level architectural calls on mission-critical services where scale, cost, and reliability are all in tension
  • Take on ambiguous, high-stakes problems that cross squad and function boundaries, and drive them to a decision when the right answer isn't obvious to anyone yet
  • Build consensus on contested technical questions across teams, and communicate the tradeoffs clearly enough that senior leadership can act on them
  • Raise the department's bar — set quality and design standards, mentor senior engineers, and turn what you know into frameworks and documentation other teams can use without you in the room
  • Drive engineering process and tooling improvements that span multiple squads, not just your own
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build
  • Interview and calibrate against our career ladder, giving honest, evidence-based assessments of candidates
  • Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages), including several as the person others turned to on architecture
  • Depth across multiple systems or domains, not just one — you've been the recognized expert in more than one place
  • A track record of designing for production reality: you quantify tradeoffs in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than picking a reasonable path and defending it
  • Experience designing observability and recovery as first-class concerns — metrics, alerting, rollback, backpressure, checkpointing — not logging added afterward
  • Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP), with relational databases (we use MySQL) and a real understanding of performance tradeoffs
  • Evidence of making other engineers better: mentorship, technical writing, design review, standards that outlasted your involvement
  • A bias for action over perfection, and the judgment to know which decisions are worth slowing down for

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $200,000 - $240,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role also carries a 10% annual bonus target. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.
  2. Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.
  4. Architecture Interview (60 mins) - A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges, tradeoffs, and failure modes.
  5. Take-Home Assignment - Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.
  6. Assignment Review Call (60 mins) - Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

data.description:
Headquarters: Remote Eastern Canada | Remote Eastern United States

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

BeyondTrust is looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to lead one of our core enterprise security product portfolios. You will own engineering for the portfolio end to end: technical direction, delivery, quality, and the people and leaders who make it happen.

Our products protect privileged access for enterprises around the world and are deployed on-premises, as appliances, and as SaaS. We are looking for a leader who can serve a demanding enterprise customer base today while moving the portfolio forward on modern cloud architecture and AI-driven engineering.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role. You will be expected to set direction, make and own significant technical and business decisions, and represent engineering with executives, product leadership, and customers.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Portfolio:

  • Set the engineering strategy and technical vision for a portfolio of enterprise security products
  • Guide cloud architecture for the portfolio's SaaS offerings on AWS, with security, reliability, and scale built in
  • Balance investment across deployment models so every customer segment is well served
  • Partner with peer engineering leaders on shared services and common architecture

Make Engineering AI-Native:

  • Lead the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic development across the organization, from design and coding through testing and release
  • Set the standards, tooling, and expectations that make AI a normal part of how teams work, and measure the impact
  • Bring AI into quality engineering and operational workflows, not just code generation

Deliver with Quality:

  • Own release quality and predictability across all deployment models
  • Champion modern quality engineering: test automation, continuous testing, and quality built into the pipeline
  • Ensure reliable, secure delivery of releases and updates to customers
  • Partner with Support and customer-facing teams on sustaining engineering and high-impact customer issues

Build Security into Delivery:

  • Own engineering's side of vulnerability response, from triage through fix to timely patch delivery
  • Partner with the security organization on threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing, and make sure findings turn into fixes
  • Treat security as a core product quality, held to the same standard as reliability and performance

Build the Organization:

  • Lead a multi-team organization of software engineers, quality engineers, and managers through directors and senior managers
  • Hire, develop, and retain a strong leadership bench
  • Establish planning and execution rhythms that give the business clear visibility into progress and risk
  • Own the engineering budget, headcount plan, and vendor and tooling decisions for the portfolio

Partner Across the Business:

  • Serve as the primary engineering counterpart to Product Management, owning feasibility and cost on roadmap commitments
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with executive leadership

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years leading multi-team organizations through managers and directors
  • A track record of delivering enterprise software with a large installed base, ideally spanning on-premises and SaaS
  • A background in secure software development: you have built and shipped security-sensitive software, worked closely with security teams on threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing, and led engineering's side of vulnerability response through fix and patch
  • Strong AWS fluency: you have led engineering for products running on AWS and can engage credibly on architecture, security, and cost
  • Hands-on conviction about AI in software engineering: you use AI tools yourself and have led their adoption across teams with measurable results
  • Experience with modern SaaS engineering practice: multi-tenant architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability
  • Experience leading quality engineering toward automation and continuous testing
  • Sound financial and vendor judgment, including build-vs-buy decisions and budget ownership
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with executives, peers, and customers

Nice To Have

  • Identity or privileged access management domain experience
  • Experience leading teams building enterprise applications on .NET (C#)
  • Experience with regulated cloud environments (FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or similar)
  • Experience delivering AI-powered product capabilities
  • Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master's a plus

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com. 

#LI-BS1

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Headquarters: United States | Remote

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart's Bank Technology team builds the internal platforms, security automation, and operational systems that enable Upstart Bank to operate securely, efficiently, and at scale. The team partners closely with stakeholders across risk, legal, compliance, security, and operations to create software solutions that support the bank's growth as a licensed financial institution.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across a growing portfolio of internal platforms and automation systems. You will drive architectural direction, solve complex technical challenges, and establish engineering patterns that enable the team to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for the bank's most critical operational functions.

How you'll make an impact

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of internal platforms, security automation systems, and workflow tooling that support Upstart Bank operations.
  • Establish scalable engineering patterns, technical standards, and system designs that enable long-term platform growth and maintainability.
  • Partner with stakeholders across risk, compliance, legal, operations, and engineering to translate complex business requirements into durable software solutions.
  • Design and oversee relational data models, authorization systems, integrations, and platform services that support secure and reliable operations.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks, making thoughtful decisions around system architecture, platform investments, and build-versus-buy tradeoffs.
  • Mentor engineers through technical leadership, architectural reviews, design documentation, and engineering best practices.
  • Drive technical strategy for internal platforms and automation initiatives as the bank expands its operational and regulatory capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 8+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale production software systems and web applications.
  • Experience leading architecture and technical design for distributed systems, platform services, or internal software platforms.
  • Experience designing relational database schemas, APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and role-based access control frameworks.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver software solutions supporting operational, compliance, security, or business-critical workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, Prisma, or similar modern application frameworks.
  • Experience building security automation, governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platforms, or operational workflow systems.
  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, banking, healthcare, or other compliance-driven environments.
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks, including SOC 2, NIST CSF, or similar regulatory standards.
  • Ability to influence technical strategy, drive alignment across teams, and navigate ambiguous problem spaces with sound engineering judgment.

Position Location - This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time Zone Requirements - This team operates on the East/West Coast time zones.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range

$190,600—$263,900 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters:

The Engineering team at Vonage is growing group of talented engineers. They face multiple challenges associated with high performance, distributed systems, and processing large volumes of data in real time.

The Vonage Verify API team is looking at expanding its size, in order to accelerate our product development to support our growing customer base, with a particular focus on adding new channels, enhanced anti-fraud measures and integration with Networks APIs to our next-generation two-factor authentication platform.

Our Engineers work on an exciting mix of both greenfield and existing projects, giving them an opportunity to explore new technologies.

What you will do:

  • Create scalable microservices that will help support our impressive growth
  • Propose scalable, maintainable and cost effective solutions
  • Estimate the effort required to develop and deliver new product features
  • Implement and execute effective testing strategies, including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests, to ensure software quality and reliability
  • Design and develop approaches to measure, evaluate and improve service quality
  • Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback to peers, and actively contribute to maintaining a high standard of code quality and development practices
  • Contribute to the documentation of the components, design patterns, and the design system to facilitate knowledge sharing and onboarding of new team members
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging frontend technologies, and share knowledge and expertise with the development team to continuously improve our development processes and standards

Tech Stack

  • Microservices architecture
  • Java or Kotlin
  • Spring Boot, Webflux, Reactive
  • AWS
  • Kafka
  • Redis, PostgreSQL
  • Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
  • Grafana, Prometheus, ELK stack

What you'll bring:

  • Excellent software engineering skills for backend services
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Engineering, Operations, and Product Management to ensure seamless integration of new features and services with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance
  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A strong focus on testing
  • An understanding of object oriented design and standard design patterns
  • Strong experience of multi-threaded, 3-tier architectures, web services, caching, and dealing with event-driven pipelines
  • Willingness to learn and use different technologies and programming languages
  • First hand knowledge of Continuous Deployment tools and methodologies
  • Experience working with public cloud. AWS would be advantageous
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
  • Practical experience of deploying code in a modern programming environment using tools such as Docker, Helm and Kubernetes

How you’ll benefit:

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Group Pension Plan
  • Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident
  • Ericsson Care Line (EAP)
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)

Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

About LastPass
LastPass delivers Secure Access Essentials, helping individuals and organizations manage and protect access to AI, applications, and credentials straight from the browser. Trusted by more than 100,000 businesses and millions of users worldwide, LastPass blends strong security with everyday simplicity. From discovering unapproved AI and applications to reducing login friction and securing credentials across the business, LastPass delivers on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected as their environments evolve.

Curious about our products? Visit our website and try it free!

We welcome new ideas, support your growth, and recognize your value, if this aligns with what you are looking for in your next career move, Join Us!

LastPass is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer:

In this role, you will evolve the LastPass browser extension. As a senior individual contributor, you will shape reliable in-browser experiences for millions of users — helping us deliver on our mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected.

About the team:

You will join the Extension team within the Web Cluster at LastPass, a group of experienced and motivated engineers building the core web experiences for consumer users, including the browser extension. The team thrives on collaboration with cross-functional experts and product leaders to deliver impactful, user-centered solutions to customers every day.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

Who will you work with?

You will work alongside engineers with diverse skills and a broad focus, whose impact reaches across the engineering organization. You will frequently partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to align on product requirements, and with cross-functional experts and leaders. Your Engineering Manager will support your onboarding, day-to-day activities, and career development.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Shape the product by designing and shipping new features that solve customer and engineering needs
  • Define the initiatives that drive the technological evolution of the application
  • Evolve the browser extension across Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, and Opera on the modern extension platform (Manifest V3, service workers, content scripts), keeping pace with changing browser capabilities
  • Creating new features for the extension, including security-related capabilities
  • Troubleshoot and debug internal and customer issues to resolve them quickly
  • Influence and shape the engineering culture, creating an environment that is fulfilling to work in and successful in meeting customer needs
  • Mentor and coach engineers in the team and organization to raise engineering capability

What does it take to work at LastPass?

  • Proven experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and React, with solid HTML and CSS fundamental
  • A track record of implementing unit and E2E tests, debugging, and integrating complex code
  • Familiarity with OOP best practices, SOLID principles, Clean Code, and software design patterns
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, deliver, and maintain quality solutions on time, using version control, build, and bug tracking systems such as Git, GitLab CI, and Jira
  • Experience with secure coding and building highly secure applications
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software development
  • Recognised for excellent problem-solving skills and good written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Known for attention to detail and strong organizational skills

It's great, but not required:

data.title: VP of Engineering
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Vice President of Engineering

Shape the future of trust in the age of AI

At Oscilar, we're building the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning™ Platform. Banks, fintechs, and digitally native organizations rely on us to manage their fraud, credit, and compliance risk with the power of AI. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and making the internet safer for everyone, this is your place.

Why join us:

  • Mission-driven teams: Work alongside industry veterans from Meta, Uber, Citi, and Confluent, all united by a shared goal to make the digital world safer.

  • Ownership and impact: We believe in extreme ownership. You'll be empowered to take responsibility, move fast, and make decisions that drive our mission forward.

  • Innovate at the cutting edge: Your work will shape how modern finance detects fraud and manages risk.

Background

Oscilar is seeking a US-based Vice President of Engineering to lead and scale our international engineering organization. In this role, you will own the technical strategy, execution, and organizational design of the engineering team, partnering closely with product, go-to-market, and executive leadership to deliver the Agentic Risk™ Platform.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who has built and led high-performing software engineering organizations in fast-moving technical environments, ideally in fintech, risk, or other regulated domains. Entrepreneurial instincts are important. The right person should be energized by setting technical direction, developing leaders, creating scalable operating systems, and driving predictable high-quality delivery as the company grows.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering leadership: Serve as the senior leader of Oscilar’s engineering organization, setting technical direction, organizational structure, and the standard for excellence across backend, frontend, AI, infrastructure, and related teams.

  • Team leadership and scaling: Lead engineering managers and senior individual contributors. Build a strong leadership bench, hire and develop high-caliber talent, and scale the organization effectively (including distributed teams).

  • Technical strategy and quality: Define and evolve the architecture, platform reliability, observability, security, and engineering practices that enable the Agentic Risk™ Platform to operate at scale. Raise the bar on technical judgment, design quality, and service ownership.

  • Operational excellence: Establish and refine scalable planning, execution, quality, and incident processes that drive predictable delivery without unnecessary overhead.

  • Cross-functional partnership: Partner closely with product, design, and executive leadership to align technical roadmaps with business goals through strong estimation, prioritization, sequencing, and trade-off decisions.

  • Distributed team effectiveness: Design operating rhythms that improve collaboration across time zones, clarify ownership, and increase engineering effectiveness as the organization scales.

  • Talent development: Hire, coach, and retain exceptional engineers and managers while fostering a high-trust, high-performance culture.

Requirements

  • Significant experience leading international software engineering organizations during hockey-stick growth at a Series B–D or comparable scale-up phase.

  • Strong track record of building, scaling, and developing engineering teams and leaders.

  • Demonstrated technical depth. We will have multiple System Design and Technical discussions during our interview process.

  • Demonstrated operational excellence, including disciplined planning processes and a high bar for predictable, high-quality execution.

  • Deep technical judgment and engineering credibility sufficient to evaluate architecture, execution risk, reliability, and technical quality.

  • Strong product engagement and an opinionated engineering voice on scaling, quality and platform investments.

  • Strong product sense and comfort partnering on roadmap, prioritization, trade-offs, and customer/business impact.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience leading or partnering across distributed teams.

  • Evidence of team building and talent development appropriate to the international remit.

  • Experience building organizations and operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

  • Experience working at an AI native company.

  • Prior founder, startup, or entrepreneurial experience is a plus.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture — work from anywhere

  • Health: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top tier plan for you and your dependents (US)

  • Balance: Unlimited PTO policy

  • Technical: AI First company; both Co-Founders are engineers at heart; and over 50% of the company is Engineering and Product

  • Culture: Family-Friendly environment; Regular team events and offsites

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities

  • Impact: Making the internet safer by protecting online transactions

data.title: Account Director, Public Sector (DACH)
data.description:
Headquarters: EMEA

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Account Director will join a team driving TRM's crypto go-to-market strategy for Public Sector customers in the DACH region. Your goal will be to increase and strengthen our foothold in the space. We're looking for a customer-focused, consultative salesperson to own the entire sales process with new and existing customers. This person will be knowledgeable about the cryptocurrency ecosystem and feel comfortable navigating complex processes to close six and seven figure deals.

The impact you will have here:

  • Account Mapping — Connect with all the current key stakeholders within your territory

  • Prospecting — Discover new stakeholders within your territory

  • Nurturing — Own, plan, execute, and/or quarterback activities to nurture client relationships, feedback loops, referrals, renewals, upsells, cross-sells, expansions

  • Account Planning — Create and execute strategic plans for your territory

  • Product and Subject Matter Expertise — Hone TRM product and customer vertical subject matter expertise

  • Customer Advocacy — Proactively gather and prioritize customer feedback and champion it within TRM

  • Loyalty — Develop a roster of happy customers that will refer new prospects, champion TRM, and provide crucial feedback

What we're looking for:

  • At least 5+ years of experience selling SaaS products into Public Sector accounts in the DACH region

  • Strong customer-facing presentation/listening skills with the ability to establish credibility with senior executives

  • A knack for storytelling — ability to understand customer needs and build compelling value propositions

  • Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly.

  • Autonomous, collaborative and an excellent communicator

About the Team:

TRM's EMEA Sales Team has a fast paced, positive and open culture. Team members are given a high degree of responsibility and autonomy. The team gets together for calls regularly. Your manager tries to be available to assist you with questions, problems or at customer meetings.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world.
