data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (SDEV)
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote (USA - New York City, NY)

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

PagerDuty is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (SRE Agent) to join our customer-focused SRE Agent team! As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work inside PagerDuty’s largest customer accounts, connecting the SRE Agent to their production environments (observability tools, infrastructure as code, GitOps tooling, and CI/CD pipelines) and guiding their teams from AI-assisted incident response to supervised and autonomous actions with safety guardrails. You will also contribute code directly back to the core SRE Agent product, building reusable tools, connectors, and skills derived from real customer needs.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product engineering team as the Staff Engineer and directly shape how agentic AI operates within the most strategic customers. The ideal candidate brings a strong background as a software engineer, hands-on experience shipping LLM/agentic systems to production, and the customer-facing skills to bridge technical execution with business strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Embed and drive SRE Agent adoption: Work onsite and in regular contact with 2–4 strategic customer teams to deploy the SRE Agent, configure tools and connectors, and embed AI actions across their incident management lifecycle to drive adoption and value 
  • Build and contribute core agent capabilities: Scope, design, and build reusable agent tools, connectors, and skills on the agent’s extensibility surfaces, shipping them through the product team's repos, review process, and evaluation gates.
  • Run pilots and unblock customer adoption: Stand up new agentic capabilities with strategic accounts first, gather eval data, identify technical blockers (permissions, telemetry, missing connectors), and build production fixes directly into the product.
  • Integrate with production stacks and progressive delivery: Connect the SRE Agent to IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms, guiding customers safely from AI-assisted to autonomous operations.
  • Set technical direction and feedback insights: Define 3–6 month technical roadmaps across assigned accounts, provide architectural guidance to product managers and engineering managers, and bring customer friction and eval data back to the core team.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of experience building and shipping production software across team boundaries (assessed against PagerDuty Staff Engineer / SDE V expectations).
  • Hands-on experience with LLM and agent systems in production, including agent development, tool-use frameworks (MCP or equivalent), evaluation pipelines, and guardrail design.
  • Customer-facing skills. You can run a technical design session with a customer’s engineers and present the business case to their leadership.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You can start from a vague problem statement in an unfamiliar environment and get to working software without much direction. Former founders and founding engineers tend to do well in this role.
  • A record of shipping software that got adopted, and the judgment to recognize which customer requests generalize and when the right answer is not to build.
  • Infrastructure & Deployment expertise: Demonstrated experience with Terraform or Pulumi at scale, GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent), CI/CD pipeline design, and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, soak periods).
  • Willingness to travel 25–50% during active customer engagements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Practical operational knowledge of incident management and observability concepts (on-call, postmortems, SLOs/SLIs, alerting).
  • Customer-facing technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or solutions architecture experience on top of a core software engineering background.
  • Background as a founder or founding engineer accustomed to navigating high ambiguity and driving unscripted problem-solving.
  • Experience with policy-as-code, fine-grained permissioning, or safety guardrail patterns for agent-driven automation.
  • Production experience with PagerDuty or competing digital operations and incident management platforms.
  • Active open-source contributions to the AI agent or Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem.

The base salary range for this position is $191,000 - $289,300 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

Your package may include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package 
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Company equity*

  • Retirement or pension plan*
  • Generous paid vacation time
  • Paid holidays and sick leave
  • Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO

  • Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year
  • Company-wide hack weeks

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.

Headquarters: Remote, USA

Joining Collibra’s Public Sector team

At Collibra Public Sector, our Professional Services team relies on Federal Solution Architects to deliver on customer expectations for the services we sell, working directly with customer key projects stakeholders throughout the entire customer journey. Ensuring growth, adoption and renewal, Federal Solution Architects act as customer champions, ensuring customers are onboarded and realizing value rapidly.

Federal Enterprise Solution Architects at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for

  • Supporting federal customer engagements by delivering mission-aligned architectural design and execution of Collibra products that adhere to Collibra Public Sector’s Delivery Models, Engagement Processes, Methodologies, and Artifacts, while ensuring compliance with applicable government regulations and security standards (e.g., FedRAMP, FISMA, GovCloud).
  • Providing federal agencies with tailored data governance strategies that incorporate best practices, enable knowledge transfer, and drive measurable business and mission outcomes.
  • Partnering cross-functionally with Collibra Sales, Customer Engineering, Product, Support, and Executive teams to ensure alignment with federal acquisition cycles and stakeholder priorities.
  • Identifying opportunities to expand Collibra’s footprint within agencies by aligning product capabilities to evolving agency mandates, modernization efforts, and compliance requirements.
  • Meeting or exceeding utilization goals in support of federal client success, long-term program engagement, and repeatable delivery excellence.
  • Contributing to the growth of Collibra’s public sector services and licensing business through account expansion, strategic planning, and customer advocacy.

You have

  • 5-10 years of consulting experience supporting U.S. federal agencies with knowledge in the areas of Data Governance, Data Management or Data Quality.
  • An understanding of the leading PaaS providers, Data Lakes, Databases, and Integration platforms commonly adopted by federal agencies.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience working with cloud platforms, network-based API integration (REST/JSON), and deployment automation.
  • Linux CLI proficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure and platform.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, and Hadoop.
  • Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that this candidate be a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil
  • Preference for candidate who holds active security clearance (Secret/TS/TS-SCI).
  • Familiarity in enterprise security solutions such as LDAP or Kerberos.
  • Hands-on experience with Data Quality, Data Pipelines, Data Orchestration, and/or Job Control tools.
  • Knowledgeable of at least least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management
  • Proficiency in leveraging APIs via Java, Python, or similar scripting language for custom software implementations in Enterprise Linux or Unix environments. 
  • Experience with data warehousing, ETL, data integration.
  • Skilled in developing functional and technical specifications.
  • Experienced with Collibra or comparable technologies.

You are

  • Preferably located in the Washington, D.C. metro area to support in-person federal customer engagements, with an on-site requirement of up to 25%.
  • An effective communicator across business and technical stakeholders and able to tailor to different audiences.
  • Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.
  • Masterful at troubleshooting, navigating, and facilitating resolution of challenging client connectivity and technical software issues. 
  • Self-starting and interested in learning new software skills to support intricacies of Collibra’s application stack. 
  • Able to work with business and IT owners to identify and align on solutions to data challenges, advocating for the importance of preserving data governance and quality.
  • Able to lead blueprinting, design workshops, and requirements gathering activities.

Measures of success

  • Within the first 30 days of employment, be able to
    • Present the services offering to your manager understanding the different deliverables and the value provided.
    • Present the Customer Journey framework to your manager understanding the different phases and roles and responsibilities within each phase.
    • Clearily understand the roles and responsibilities of all delivery personnel including an Engagement Manager, Solution Architect, Account Program Manager, Premium Support Engineer, Sales Engineer and Account Executive.
    • Work with the account team to build project plans aligned to each assigned account.
    • Have a baseline understanding of the Collibra product and associated features.
  • Within the first 60 days of employment
    • Clearly understand and present the functions and features of the product with your manager.
    • Show an intermediate understanding of the product with the ability to architect solutions.
  • Within the first 90 days of employment be able to
    • Execute on customer project plans based on product knowledge for assigned customers.
    • Understand and convey to customers how Collibra's suite product capabilities and the projects being delivered provide value to customers.
    • Design architectural solutions aligned with customer initiatives.

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $128,000 - 160,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

At Regnology our greatest asset is our people. We value diversity and foster an inclusive environment that supports learning, safety, and growth. By investing in our team, listening to customers, and encouraging creativity, we drive continuous innovation and improvement.

Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

What you’ll do

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our SaaS Onboarding team. In this role, you’ll mainly contribute to onboarding new and existing clients to Regnology Cloud, a SaaS platform to deploy and manage Regnology product instances in Google Cloud. You will own onboarding projects from start to finish: internal alignment and customer kick-off, then technical and business go-live, then handover to our run teams. data.description:
IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including Spain, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands.

Pay: $320,000–$500,000/yr

Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Infrastructure

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who thinks beyond traditional DevOps. You'll own infrastructure reliability, scalability, and observability while pushing toward a future where infrastructure increasingly manages itself through AI agents and intelligent automation.

You'll work across cloud infrastructure, deployment systems, monitoring, security, and incident response, building the tools and workflows that allow a small engineering team to move exceptionally fast without compromising reliability.

We're looking for someone who has operated complex production systems, understands infrastructure at a deep level, and is already using AI coding agents to fundamentally change how engineering work gets done.

What You'll Do

  1. Build agentic infrastructure: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for infrastructure provisioning, deployments, monitoring, incident detection, and automated remediation.
  2. Own reliability at scale: Architect resilient, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure that supports rapidly evolving AI products and workloads.
  3. Make systems observable: Build comprehensive logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting systems that provide actionable visibility into production health.
  4. Automate operational complexity: Eliminate repetitive infrastructure work through intelligent automation, self-service tooling, and agent-driven operations.
  5. Own infrastructure lifecycle management: Drive cloud security hygiene, dependency upgrades, runtime migrations, and infrastructure modernization from design through production.
  6. Improve developer velocity: Build infrastructure platforms and workflows that make deploying, debugging, and operating services effortless for engineers.
  7. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish technical standards, and influence architectural decisions through hands-on technical leadership.

What We're Looking For

  1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering.
  2. Strong hands-on experience operating production systems on major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  3. Expertise in infrastructure as code, container orchestration, CI/CD, networking, cloud security, and distributed systems.
  4. Demonstrated experience designing observability and incident response systems for complex production environments.
  5. Proven ownership of infrastructure migrations, security improvements, and reliability initiatives.
  6. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively in your daily development workflow and have built automation that meaningfully reduces engineering toil.
  7. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build internal tools, automation frameworks, and production-grade infrastructure services.
  8. A track record of independently identifying systemic problems, designing solutions, and shipping them end to end.
  9. Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Nice to have

  1. You've built infrastructure automation that eliminates entire categories of manual operational work.
  2. You've experimented with or deployed AI agents for infrastructure operations, incident triage, or automated remediation.
  3. You think about infrastructure as a programmable, increasingly autonomous system rather than a collection of manually managed services.
  4. You've helped small engineering teams operate highly reliable systems at significant scale.
  5. You're equally comfortable debugging a production incident, designing infrastructure architecture, and writing the code to improve both.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

data.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic Mainframe Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end architectural design, integration, and modernization roadmap of our mission-critical IBM Z enterprise systems. In this role, you will bridge core legacy platforms with modern distributed and cloud ecosystems, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and alignment with long-term business objectives.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and govern end-to-end technical architectures across mainframe (z/OS) and hybrid cloud/distributed environments.

  • Lead solution design for core system enhancements, API enablement, data replication, and legacy modernization initiatives.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, and engineering leads to translate complex functional requirements into scalable architectural blueprints.

  • Evaluate and recommend modernization patterns (e.g., API wrapping, refactoring, co-existence, or rehosting) while minimizing operational risk and downtime.

  • Establish non-functional requirements covering transaction throughput, disaster recovery, security compliance, and high availability.

  • Provide architectural oversight, technical mentorship, and design reviews for onshore and offshore mainframe development teams.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in mainframe engineering, with at least 3+ years in a Solution Architect or Principal Technical Lead capacity.

  • Comprehensive mastery of the IBM z/OS ecosystem, including COBOL, JCL, DB2, CICS, VSAM, and IBM MQ.

  • Proven track record architecting hybrid integrations between mainframe backends and modern distributed/cloud platforms (REST APIs, microservices, Kafka).

  • Strong understanding of enterprise security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards in banking or financial services.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills with the ability to present complex architectural trade-offs to both technical and executive audiences.

Technical Depth

  • Deep architectural knowledge of high-volume online transaction processing (CICS/IMS) and large-scale batch processing patterns.

  • Hands-on familiarity with integration and modernization middleware such as IBM z/OS Connect, MQSeries, CDC (Change Data Capture), or API gateways.

  • Strong grasp of database architecture, capacity planning, and system-level performance optimization on DB2 for z/OS.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and mainframe-to-cloud migration or re-platforming projects.

  • Familiarity with modern mainframe DevOps toolchains (Git, Jenkins, IBM Developer for z/OS, SonarQube).

  • Relevant architectural certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, or IBM Z certifications).

data.title: Applied AI Engineer
data.description:
About Monte Carlo

Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI. Bayes, our AI teammate, does the work: detecting, triaging, troubleshooting, and fixing issues in AI agents and the data powering them. The result is self-improving agents that get better with every fix instead of drifting. More than 400 enterprises, including Amazon, PepsiCo, CNN, Nasdaq, and JetBlue, rely on Monte Carlo. Learn more at montecarlo.ai.

The Role

We're building the products that tell enterprises whether their AI agents can be trusted — and we need someone who works end to end, from an ambiguous problem statement through research, prototyping, and production. You'd get the problem, not the spec: research the approaches, prototype, prove what works, build it, and integrate it into the platform alongside our engineering and data science teams. This role exists because agent observability moved from roadmap to revenue faster than anyone predicted, and the work is now on the critical path.

What You'll Do

  • Take an open problem end-to-end — from research and prototyping through production, killing what doesn't work before it becomes someone's roadmap
  • Design and ship agent-powered features — root-cause analysis, incident triage, monitor generation — and integrate them into the platform with our engineering team
  • Build the eval infrastructure that makes those features safe to change: golden datasets, regression suites, offline and online scoring, and the judgment calls about what "good" means
  • Own retrieval and context pipelines over customer metadata, lineage, and query history, and instrument agent behavior in production — traces, failure taxonomies, cost and latency budgets — to close the loop on quality
  • Partner with data science on detection quality and experiment design, and with PM on what an agent should do versus what it merely can do
  • Set the technical bar for how we build with LLMs — patterns, guardrails, and the internal tooling other engineers reuse

What We're Looking For

  • You've built agents in production with real users. Not integrated a framework. Not worked on a team that had one. Built them — agents with real autonomy and internal loops, where the model uses tools and decides what to do next without a human in the middle, and you kept them running once real users showed up. RAG with a wrapper doesn't count. Neither does a set of MCP tools point at an API.
  • You've run evals and monitored agents after launch. Agents are non-deterministic, so normal tests don't work on them. You've owned an eval framework — golden datasets, regression suites, offline and online scoring — not a folder of one-off scripts. And you've watched agents in production, not just in dev.
  • Python, plus an ML or data science background. Python is your daily language and you're solid on the backend, though you don't need to be a distributed systems specialist. You understand models well enough to reason about how they behave — you're not an application engineer calling someone else's API.
  • 3+ years in ML, data science, or software engineering — at companies that ship quickly. Startups, AI-native teams, or high-growth product companies where the release cadence is measured in weeks, not quarters. If all of your experience sits inside large, process-heavy organizations with the platform already built for you, this seat will be a hard adjustment.
  • You work from a problem, not a spec. Handed an ambiguous problem statement, you design the experiment, build the smallest version to test it, and take what works into production.
  • You use AI tools every day. Claude or its equivalents are part of how you write code and do research, not something you tried once. This is backend and model layer work, by the way — no frontend.
  • You'd rather ship than polish. Most of this work needs a good answer quickly, not a perfect one eventually. You can tell which problems are the exception and deserve real depth — and you'll say no to the version that demos well and falls apart in production.
  • Nice to have: statistics and hypothesis testing, applied rather than theoretical. Building and maintaining MCP servers. Experience in the data and cloud space — Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Airflow.

This Is Not For You If

  • Your AI work is retrieval with a wrapper, or MCP tools pointed at an API — nothing that decides and acts on its own
  • Your LLM experience is prototypes, notebooks, and demos that never carried production traffic
  • You need a fully specified problem before you start, or you're uncomfortable with the ambiguity of a category being invented in real time

Why Monte Carlo

  • We created the data observability category, and we're doing it again with agent trust — you'll build where the market is forming, not where it's settled
  • Series D, $236M raised, backed by Accel, Redpoint, Notable Capital, ICONIQ Growth, and Salesforce Ventures
  • Customers include HubSpot, Fox, Nasdaq, Toast, and Mercado Libre — your work ships to enterprises with real stakes
  • Snowflake Partner of the Year and a verified connector in Anthropic's Claude AI directory
  • Remote-first by design since day one, and recognized as a Best Workplace for it
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and a remote-first environment.

data.title: AI Engineer
data.description:
This role is remote, and you must work Eastern time hours. New York is preferred. Candidates on West Coast or Central time are not a fit.

We are helping a venture backed Series A AI startup hire AI engineers. The company builds custom AI systems that carry approved, high stakes work across the systems a large regulated enterprise already uses, including older private systems.

Each deployment is a tailored version of the core platform, run end to end inside the customer's own environment, because data in these industries cannot leave the customer's infrastructure. The customer's policies decide what the system can do. When a judgment call is needed, the work goes back to a person with the evidence already assembled. Every run leaves an audit trail. Operating data stays with that customer and is not shared. The company can run on the customer's chosen foundation model, and it keeps control of its own model stack, including its own compute.

The company works like an applied research lab that cares most about getting models into production and solving customer problems. The team has strong research backgrounds. Many of the research and engineering people have worked together before, including at a previous company the founders built. It has closed large enterprise deals with major financial institutions and is growing quickly. The core engineering team is overseas, and the US team overlaps with it on Eastern time. The structure is flat, and engineers own their work end to end. A New York office is being set up.

What you will do

  • Own the technical build of a customized version of the company's AI platform for a major enterprise customer, from architecture to deployment.
  • Adapt and extend the core platform for the customer's environment, and merge customer specific work back into the main product.
  • Work every day with the core engineering team abroad, overlapping on Eastern time.
  • Own production deployments, integrations and the reliability of large language model systems in a regulated enterprise environment.
  • Build back end and full stack features in Python: APIs, integrations and deployments for AI powered products.
  • Serve as a go to technical contact for the customer's engineering stakeholders. Expect about 20 percent of your time to be customer facing.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive fixes end to end with a high degree of independence.
  • Help shape how the US engineering team works as it grows.

What you need

  • 6 to 12 years in back end or AI engineering, building and deploying large language model systems in production.
  • Your last 2 to 3 years as an engineer at a high growth, venture backed Series A through Series D AI startup shipping product to enterprise customers.
  • Large language model or agentic workflows you built and shipped that run in production for external customers. Internal tools and prototypes do not count.
  • Strong software architecture and system design, and the ability to own technical delivery end to end.
  • Back end or full stack software engineering in Python.
  • A degree in computer science or a related field.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers or their technical teams, ideally in banking or another regulated industry.
  • You live on the US East Coast and work Eastern time hours.

Nice to have

  • Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability tooling.

What this search is not

  • Candidates with more than 12 years of experience are not a fit for this role.
  • Candidates coming from Big Tech, a large bank, a large enterprise, a consulting firm, venture capital or asset management are not a fit, even with AI titles.
  • Data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers and SRE or DevOps profiles whose main work is not software engineering are not a fit.
  • Research or academic AI experience without production deployments is not a fit.
  • Recent history of several stints of about a year or less, without a clear reason, is not a fit.
  • Candidates on West Coast or Central time are not a fit.

Location

  • Remote, with New York preferred. A New York office is being set up.
  • Eastern time hours only.
  • Visa transfers can be considered.
  • Full time, direct hire role. Equity is part of the offer.

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

How can we use vast amounts of proprietary and internet-scale healthcare data to build systems that enable access to significantly better health care? In this role as Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will define and drive the architectural vision for large-scale, foundational machine learning models and applications that power care personalization, treatment intelligence, and automation at scale. Your work will directly impact every aspect of patient care, including but not limited to MedMatch, our AI-powered system that enhances provider-patient interactions, optimizes treatment recommendations, and expands into new verticals. This impact will be driven by architecting resilient, scalable, and extensible ML platforms that accelerate product development, unlock intelligent care delivery, and influence long-term ML strategy and engineering practices across teams.

You Will:

  • Define and drive the architectural vision for ML and LLM systems that support treatment recommendation, personalization, and intelligent care delivery at scale

  • Establish foundational design patterns and infrastructure practices that ensure systems are scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable

  • Work hands-on with Python and ML frameworks like PyTorch to prototype, optimize, and guide implementation of complex model pipelines and platform components

  • Align high-impact technical decisions with long-term product strategy by partnering with platform, product, and clinical teams

  • Architect and evolve robust ML infrastructure to support continuous training, real-time inference, evaluation, and observability

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that simplify system complexity, improve developer velocity, and increase organizational leverage

  • Shape quality strategies across teams by defining standards for testing, observability, performance, and operational risk

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers across squads, supporting their growth as systems thinkers and technical leaders

  • Champion a culture of sustainable speed, system ownership, and architectural clarity across product and platform teams

You Have:

  • Demonstrated success in designing, scaling, and evolving ML platforms that support production-grade training, deployment, real-time inference, and monitoring

data.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

UpGuard has recently replatformed its analytics stack onto a greenfield foundation built on BigQuery, dbt, infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, CI/CD through GitHub, and a governed semantic layer that both people and AI agents query. We are seeking an experienced data engineer to help take that platform to the next level.

Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, this role is the strong technical lead within the data engineering team. You will work under the Director's guidance to evolve the platform and raise its engineering standards, and you will set the example for how the team builds, reviews and ships.

The platform has a broad contributor and consumer base. Analysts, data scientists and business teams build on it, query it and increasingly reach it through AI agents. Keeping those stakeholders well served and satisfied is a central measure of success in this role.

What will you do?

  • Technical Leadership: Act as the senior technical voice within the data engineering team by guiding design decisions, reviewing code, mentoring engineers and contributing to the platform roadmap set by the team.

  • Platform Evolution: Help take UpGuard's recently built GCP data platform to its next stage, proposing and delivering improvements to scale, reliability, performance, cost and AI workflows.

  • Engineering Standards & CI/CD: Raise engineering standards across the platform, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, PR checks, BI model validation and developer environments that keep changes safe to ship.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Satisfaction: Treat the analysts, data scientists, and business teams who depend on the platform as customers. Understand their needs, scope and prioritise requests with them, set clear expectations, follow through on commitments, and track how well the platform serves them.

  • Contributor Enablement: Support the growing group of analysts, data scientists and business users who contribute dbt code, through onboarding, documentation, AI agents, review practices and developer tooling that make good contributions the easy path.

  • Data Integration: Design, build and maintain reliable pipelines that bring data from internal systems (CRM, billing, support, marketing automation and product events) and third-party sources into BigQuery using managed connectors, event streams and vendor APIs, and write data back to operational systems where needed.

  • Platform Operations & Maintenance: Manage infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, run containerised workloads on Docker and Kubernetes, maintain build scheduling and deployment pipelines, and keep the platform monitored, patched and well documented.

  • dbt Development: Author and review dbt models across the staging, source-level and business-level layers, and uphold the team's conventions for modelling, grain testing and documentation.

  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data tests, source freshness checks, observability and alerting, and take part in incident response so that problems are caught and fixed before stakeholders find them.

  • Data Governance & Privacy: Implement access controls as code, process access requests, and apply data classification, PII masking, audit logging and data subject request handling in line with the team's governance policies.

  • AI Enablement & Conversational Analytics: Build and operate the data, semantic layer and tooling that power conversational analytics and AI agents, including MCP access, context and evaluation that let LLMs query structured and unstructured business data accurately and safely.

What will you bring?

  • Proven Experience: 5+ years in data engineering, including significant hands-on work on a production cloud data platform.

  • Technical Leadership: Experience as a tech lead or senior engineer guiding the work of others through design review, code review and mentoring.

  • AI Fluency: Fluency using AI/LLM tools to accelerate development, review and documentation.

  • Stakeholder & Consulting Skills: A track record of engaging stakeholders, scoping ambiguous requests, managing expectations and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.

  • dbt Expertise: Very strong, hands-on dbt development covering modular modelling, testing, macros, packages, snapshots, documentation and performance tuning at scale. Experience with a semantic layer such as MetricFlow, Omni’s YAML or LookML is valued.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience managing cloud infrastructure with OpenTofu, CDK or Terraform.

  • Containers & Orchestration: Confidence running workloads on Docker and Kubernetes, ideally GKE.

  • Experience with Dimensional Data Modeling techniques and complexities

  • Data Integration: Experience with managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Airbyte, event pipelines such as Segment or Pub/Sub, and REST APIs.

  • Data Quality & Governance: Practical experience implementing data testing, observability tooling such as Elementary, access controls and data masking.

  • BigQuery: Deep working knowledge of BigQuery, including partitioning, clustering, cost and quota management, IAM and complex SQL.

  • Proven ability to implement PII detection, masking, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated data lifecycle policies in modern cloud data platforms.

What will give you an edge?

  • Conversational Analytics & AI Management: Experience building or operating conversational analytics, MCP servers, retrieval or tool-calling layers for LLM agents, or evaluation frameworks that measure the accuracy of AI answers on business data.

  • B2B SaaS Experience: Experience working within a software organisation, ideally a B2B SaaS business, and familiarity with metrics such as ARR, NRR/GRR, pipeline and churn.

  • CRM Systems: A firm understanding of CRM data models such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including deals, pipelines, lifecycle stages and property history, and how that data flows into analytics.

  • Modern BI: Familiarity with Looker, Omni or a comparable modern BI tool, and an understanding of how semantic models and BI layers consume warehouse data.

  • Data governance experience in heavily regulated industries or access control around highly sensitive data

  • Hands-on experience designing data architectures compliant with GDPR, the Australian Privacy Act, or similar global privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA/CPRA).

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

Snowflake Data Engineer (Data Warehouse Programmer-Analyst)

Job no: 494296
Work type: Full Time
Location: 505 City Parkway West
Categories: Information Technology

Join Us in this Amazing Opportunity

The Team You'll Join

We are a mission driven community-based organization that serves member health with excellence and dignity, respecting the value and needs of each person. If you are ready to advance your career while making a difference, we encourage you to review and apply today and help us build healthier communities for all.

More About the Opportunity

We are hoping you will join us as a Snowflake Data Engineer (Data Warehouse Programmer-Analyst) and help shape the future of healthcare where you'll be an integral part of our Data Warehouse team, helping to strive for excellence while we serve our member health with dignity, respecting the value and needs of each of our members through collaboration with our providers, community partners and local stakeholders. This position has been approved to be Full Telework.

  • If telework is approved, you are required to work within the State of California only and if Partial Telework, also come in to the Main Office in Orange, CA, at least two (2) days per week minimum.


The Data Warehouse Programmer-Analyst (Snowflake Data Engineer) will be responsible for leading hands-on engineering to build CalOptima Health's new enterprise data warehouse on the Snowflake data platform, replacing the existing Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse. You will design source-to-target mappings and build new dbt models that move raw data through the Bronze and Silver layers into Gold data marts. In collaboration with Data Governance, the incumbent will confirm which legacy business rules still apply and validate the new warehouse against source systems and legacy results. Additionally, you will support and enhance the existing SQL Server data warehouse until the new warehouse is implemented. Together, we are building a stronger, more equitable health system.

Your Contributions To the Team:

  • 90% - Technical Responsibilities
    • Assists the team in fulfilling departmental responsibilities and collaborates with others to support short- and long-term goals and priorities for the department.
    • Participates in a mission-driven culture of high-quality performance, with a member focus on customer service, consistency, dignity and accountability.
    • Leads hands-on engineering to build the new enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake, replacing the existing SQL Server data warehouse.
    • Reviews legacy schemas, T-SQL stored procedures, SSIS packages and SQL Agent jobs to understand the business rules and data requirements the new warehouse must meet.
    • Designs source-to-target mappings from source systems to the Bronze and Silver layers and from the Silver layer to Gold data marts.
    • Develops and validates dbt models for Silver, Gold, and conformed data layers, converting legacy T-SQL to Snowflake SQL and documenting material variances.
    • Designs and implements ingestion pipelines and orchestration to load raw data into the Bronze layer using enterprise-approved technologies (e.g., Openflow, Snowpipe, Azure Data Factory, tasks and streams, the enterprise job scheduler).
    • Establishes reusable patterns for incremental processing, dependency management, error handling, and testing across dbt models and pipelines.
    • Supports parallel validation, defect resolution, cutover readiness and post-cutover verification until the new warehouse is stable and legacy assets are retired.
    • Stores all dbt and Snowflake code in GitHub and releases it to test and production via the automated deployment process maintained by Data Operations.
    • Tunes dbt models and queries for performance and cost through pruning, clustering, and query profiling, and collaborates with Data Operations on warehouse sizing.
    • Queries and analyzes large-scale health care datasets (provider, member, eligibility, claims, and authorizations) to support data modeling and validation.
    • Troubleshoots failures in data warehouse pipelines and models, performs root cause analysis, and collaborates with Data Operations on monitoring and alerting.
    • Supports and enhances the existing SQL Server data warehouse during the transition, including resolving production issues.
    • Documents the requirements for each new workload for virtual warehouses, roles, masking, and row access, and provides those requirements to Data Operations and the platform administrator for implementation.
    • Works with Data Governance to confirm which legacy business rules are carried over into the new warehouse.
    • Applies health care privacy and security requirements to all work, including the handling of protected health information and the use of masked data in non-production environments.
    • Adheres to change control for production releases, including peer review and change advisory board approval.
    • Evaluates new Snowflake data engineering capabilities (e.g., dynamic tables, hybrid tables, Snowpark) and recommends those that measurably improve data models and pipelines.
    • Shares Snowflake and dbt knowledge with teammates through code reviews and working sessions.
    • Works with external vendors and consultants, reviewing their designs and code so the team can support their deliverables.
    • Collaborates with business owners to understand legacy workflows, plan cutover strategies, and ensure continuity of reporting and operational processes throughout the transition.
    • Documents design decisions and playbooks to accelerate ongoing platform modernization.
    • Reports modernization progress, risks and decisions to leadership on a regular cadence to ensure visibility and alignment with the enterprise data strategy.
    • Manages multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with stakeholder expectations.
  • 10% - Other
    • Completes other projects and duties as assigned.


Do You Have What the Role Requires?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, health informatics, data analytics or a related field PLUS 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, database development or platform modernization required an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the position may also be qualifying.
  • 3 years of hands-on experience with Snowflake specifically in building pipelines, data modeling, transformations, and performance tuning.
  • 3 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL, including analysis of stored procedures and ETL logic.
  • Experience designing data models and source-to-target mappings for a data warehouse.
  • Hands-on experience building transformation models using dbt or a comparable SQL-based transformation framework.
  • Experience testing data pipelines or models against source data before release.
  • Experience working with sensitive or regulated data and adhering to applicable privacy and security requirements.


You'll Stand Out More If You Possess the Following:

  • Master's degree in computer science, health informatics, data analytics or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer, dbt, Azure).
  • 3 years of hands-on experience working with health care data and familiarity with HIPAA compliance.
  • Experience working in a health care payer environment supporting multiple lines of business (Medicaid, Medicare, commercial exchange, dual-eligible).
  • Demonstrated experience building a new data warehouse on Snowflake that replaced a SQL Server warehouse, from design through cutover and decommissioning.
  • Experience designing governed data models with dbt and the medallion architecture.
  • Experience with Snowflake on Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience with Snowflake Openflow or comparable ingestion tools.
  • Experience with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Scala) for automation and analysis.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., GitHub, Azure DevOps) for data workf
  • Experience reading SSIS packages to understand legacy ETL logic.
  • Experience mentoring or training engineers transitioning from SQL Server to Snowflake.
  • Experience reviewing technical work delivered by a vendor or a consultant.


What the Regulatory Agencies Need You to Possess?

  • n/a


Your Knowledge & Abilities to Bring to this Role:

  • Develop rapport and establish and maintain effective working relationships with CalOptima Health's leadership and staff and external contacts at all levels and with diverse backgrounds.
  • Work independently and exercise sound judgment.
  • Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
  • Work a flexible schedule available to participate in evening and weekend events.
  • Organize, be analytical, problem-solve and possess project management skills.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment and in an efficient manner.
  • Manage multiple projects and identify opportunities for internal and external collaboration.
  • Motivate and lead multi-program teams and external committees/coalitions.
  • Utilize computer and appropriate software (e.g., Microsoft Office: Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint) and job specific applications/systems to produce correspondence, charts, spreadsheets, and/or other information applicable to the position assignment.


Your Physical Requirements (With or Without Accommodations):

  • Ability to visually read information from computer screens, forms and other printed materials and information.
  • Ability to speak (enunciate) clearly in conversation and general communication.
  • Hearing ability for verbal communication/conversation/responses via telephone, telephone systems, and face-to-face interactions.
  • Manual dexterity for typing, writing, standing and reaching, flexibility, body movement for bending, crouching, walking, kneeling and prolonged sitting.
  • Lifting and moving objects, patients and/or equipment 10 to 25 pounds


Ways We Are Here For You

  • You'll enjoy competitive compensation for this role.
    • Our current hiring range is: Pay Grade: 314 - $99,902 - $159,843 ($48.03 - $76.8476).
      • The final salary offered will be based on education, job-related knowledge and experience, skills relevant to the role and internal equity among other factors.
  • This position is approved for Full Telework (**If the position is Telework, it is eligible in California only**)
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • CalPERS pension program and additional retirement packages.
  • Additional benefits and perks including:
    • A generous PTO program
    • A quality work life balance
    • Various wellness programs
    • Tuition Reimbursement
    • Professional development opportunities
    • Career development opportunities
    • Flexible scheduling
    • And the satisfaction of knowing your work directly impacts and improves healthcare access for thousands of individuals and families.


Our Work Environment:

If located at the 500, 505 Building or a remote work location:

  • Work is typically indoors and sedentary and is subject to schedule changes and/or variable work hours, with travel as needed.
  • There are no harmful environmental conditions present for this job.
  • The noise level in this work environment is usually moderate.

If located in the Community:

Why Join Us?

We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. Each employee brings a unique perspective to the overall team and we value everyone's input and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where you and every team member can thrive while making a meaningful impacts on our community members. Our team reflects and represents the communities we serve, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds who share our commitment to accessible, quality healthcare.

What's Your Next Step?

All Applications will be accepted on a continuous basis until a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received. Do NOT miss out. If you want to join our team, the deadline for the first review of applications is December 8, 2026 at 9:00 PM (PST). We are encouraging you to apply early. If you apply after the first review date, your application is not guaranteed to be considered for this recruitment. This recruitment may close at any time without notice after the first review date.

Our Commitment to You

If you make it through the steps above and are selected for this exciting role, you will be required to undergo a reference and a background check (to include a conviction record) and if applicable also pass a drug screening and/or a post-offer pre-employment medical examination (for specific positions) If you are an Internal CalOptima Health applicant, please apply through the internal portal on InfoNet.

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A tech-forward real estate brokerage headquartered in New York that grew from a top-ranked sales team into a full-service firm. The company combines traditional brokerage services with in-house media production, branding and a proprietary marketing technology platform, redefining how listings reach buyers in a fast-changing market.


Job Summary

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to build the pipelines behind our client’s data advantage: listing data from dozens of MLS feeds, conversations from its AI assistant, and the deal outcomes that tie them together. Reporting to the Principal Data Engineer in a small, growing and AI-forward data team, you’ll own the ingestion of new data sources, make the listings pipeline failover-safe, and backfill years of listing history into the lakehouse. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems from messy real-world data and uses AI tools to do it faster.

Responsibilities

  • Build and run ingestion for new data sources, including additional MLS feeds, listing data partners, and public and private records.

  • Make the listings pipeline reliable: CDC that survives database failovers, freshness monitoring, and alerting when feeds lag.

  • Backfill three years of historical listing data into the lakehouse and build the archival access patterns that read from it.

  • Build raw, cleaned and modeled layers in dbt, including normalization across feeds and entity resolution for properties, agents and offices.

  • Add tests, data contracts and drift detection across roughly 160 listing fields, respecting each MLS’s data-use rules.

  • Model AI assistant conversations, product events and deal outcomes so product and leadership can measure what’s working.

  • Help consolidate and right-size the ClickHouse footprint for cost and performance.

  • Write specs before code and use AI coding tools daily to move faster.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience building production pipelines.

  • Strong SQL and Python; working knowledge of TypeScript is a plus.

  • Hands-on Postgres experience, including logical replication or CDC.

  • Experience with an analytical database (ClickHouse preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift are also a fit).

  • Experience with dbt, building tested and documented models.

  • Experience with lakehouse or object-storage formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Delta).

  • Experience normalizing messy, inconsistent third-party data into a reliable model.

  • Daily, practical use of AI coding assistants.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

A tech-forward real estate brokerage headquartered in New York that grew from a top-ranked sales team into a full-service firm. The company combines traditional brokerage services with in-house media production, branding and a proprietary marketing technology platform, redefining how listings reach buyers in a fast-changing market.


Job Summary

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Data Engineer to build the pipelines behind our client’s data advantage: listing data from dozens of MLS feeds, conversations from its AI assistant, and the deal outcomes that tie them together. Reporting to the Principal Data Engineer in a small, growing and AI-forward data team, you’ll own the ingestion of new data sources, make the listings pipeline failover-safe, and backfill years of listing history into the lakehouse. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems from messy real-world data and uses AI tools to do it faster.

Responsibilities

  • Build and run ingestion for new data sources, including additional MLS feeds, listing data partners, and public and private records.

  • Make the listings pipeline reliable: CDC that survives database failovers, freshness monitoring, and alerting when feeds lag.

  • Backfill three years of historical listing data into the lakehouse and build the archival access patterns that read from it.

  • Build raw, cleaned and modeled layers in dbt, including normalization across feeds and entity resolution for properties, agents and offices.

  • Add tests, data contracts and drift detection across roughly 160 listing fields, respecting each MLS’s data-use rules.

  • Model AI assistant conversations, product events and deal outcomes so product and leadership can measure what’s working.

  • Help consolidate and right-size the ClickHouse footprint for cost and performance.

  • Write specs before code and use AI coding tools daily to move faster.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience building production pipelines.

  • Strong SQL and Python; working knowledge of TypeScript is a plus.

  • Hands-on Postgres experience, including logical replication or CDC.

  • Experience with an analytical database (ClickHouse preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift are also a fit).

  • Experience with dbt, building tested and documented models.

  • Experience with lakehouse or object-storage formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Delta).

  • Experience normalizing messy, inconsistent third-party data into a reliable model.

  • Daily, practical use of AI coding assistants.

What We Offer

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

data.title: Senior Clinical Data Visualization Developer (Permanent Home based)
data.description:
Senior Clinical Data Visualization Developer will be responsible for supporting medium‑complexity data visualization mapping and set‑up activities across clinical programs. The role requires strong technical expertise, independent problem‑solving, and the ability to translate business needs into clear, accurate, and compliant visual data outputs. The developer will also support junior team members when needed but will not serve in a lead or supervisory capacity.

The position involves working with business users to define requirements; profiling and mapping clinical and operational data; designing and testing visualization models; ensuring governance and compliance; and providing clear explanations of visual outputs and associated limitations. The developer will also contribute to information lifecycle management within visualization solutions and support compliant access to clinical data. Collaboration with Privacy, Risk, Assurance, Information Security and other regulatory functions is expected to ensure data standards and controls are consistently met.

The role also includes developing deeper expertise in clinical data standards, visualization techniques, metadata models, and tools. The developer will gradually build domain knowledge within at least one therapeutic area and maintain a good understanding of roles and processes across drug development.

Education & Background Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analysis, Big Data, Quantitative Methods, Bioinformatics, Data Analytics, OR a life‑science field (e.g., Biotechnology, Molecular Biology) with proven data‑analysis experience (e.g., GitHub projects, Kaggle work, publications).
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Effective organization, attention to detail, and accuracy.
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving ability.
  • Ability to leverage data to address business challenges and provide meaningful insights to medical reviewers.
  • Methodical working style with a focus on high‑quality output.

Technical Skills

  • Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Programming experience in R or Python for data processing, analysis, and presentation.
  • Good proficiency in at least two core areas: R, Python, Power BI (or equivalent).
  • SQL familiarity is a strong advantage.

Optional / Nice‑to‑Have

  • General understanding or interest in clinical trials and the drug development process.
  • Basic knowledge of SAS
  • Exposure to project coordination or basic project management tasks.

data.title: Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics
data.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics

Labcorp is seeking a remote-based Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics to join our team!

Responsibilities:

Pricing & Demand Modeling

  • Lead price elasticity, demand forecasting, and scenario modeling to inform pricing, promotional, subscription, bundling, margin, and portfolio decisions.
  • Evaluate pricing opportunities and risks by balancing consumer demand, competitive dynamics, and business objectives.
  • Establish pricing frameworks and governance that support profitable, data-driven decision making.

Customer Economics & Growth Performance

  • Develop customer lifetime value (LTV), cohort, and retention frameworks.
  • Analyze customer, transaction, and product performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, average order value (AOV), and long-term customer value.
  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Product, and Merchandising leaders to align growth strategies with financial outcomes.

Experimentation, Measurement & Performance Insights

  • Partner on testing and experimentation strategies for pricing, promotions, subscriptions, bundles, and customer offers.
  • Establish measurement methodologies and success metrics that quantify initiative performance and business impact.
  • Develop executive reporting and performance insights that provide visibility into pricing effectiveness, customer economics, and growth initiatives.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that enable continuous optimization and informed decision making.

Competitive & Market Intelligence

  • Lead competitive intelligence efforts across pricing, product assortment, promotions, industry trends, and competitors.
  • Monitor consumer and market trends to identify opportunities, risks, and shifts in competitive positioning.
  • Translate market intelligence into strategic insights that inform portfolio, pricing, and growth strategies.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to scale competitive intelligence, identify emerging trends, and enhance predictive insights.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or Mathematics.
  • 7 or more years of experience in pricing analytics, revenue management, customer economics, commercial analytics or business intelligence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA).

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, consumer health, or other highly regulated industries where pricing decisions must balance customer value, compliance, and business objectives.
  • Demonstrated success building pricing and analytics management capabilities from the ground up, including frameworks, governance, tools, and measurement approaches.
  • Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, pricing decisions, competitive intelligence, and business performance.
  • Strong quantitative skills — comfort building pricing models, running elasticity analysis, and translating data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer (DTC), ecommerce, marketplace, retail, and/or consumer-focused digital health businesses.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based products, membership programs, or recurring revenue businesses.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining pricing optimization, price elasticity, demand forecasting, customer lifetime value, and scenario-planning models.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience translating large datasets into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience pricing products sold directly to consumers (as opposed to purely B2B or payer-negotiated pricing)
  • Track record of partnering cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Merchandising, and Finance
  • Advanced Excel/modeling skills; experience with pricing or BI tools (e.g., SQL, Looker, Tableau)
  • Excellent communication skills — able to present pricing recommendations to executives and translate strategy into simple, actionable guidance for go-to-market teams


About the Role

Labcorp OnDemand is a DTC consumer testing business growing rapidly within the expanding consumer health market.

As Director, Consumer Pricing & Analytics, you will play a foundational role in developing the models and insights that inform pricing decisions for direct-to-consumer diagnostic products in a market shaped by payer dynamics, out-of-pocket consumer spend, regulatory considerations, and competitive lab/testing offerings.

You'll build the pricing frameworks and governance that let the business grow profitably while staying accessible to the consumers we serve. This role is directly responsible for tying pricing decisions to business outcomes — including revenue growth targets, margin goals, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV) improvement, and subscription growth.

The ideal candidate brings experience from a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, retail, and/or digital health consumer business and has a proven track record of translating complex data into actionable commercial recommendations.

This role is remote-based in the US.

Application Window: Application window will close on December 11, 2026.

Pay Range: $150,000 - $165,000 annually + annual bonus eligibility.

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. The position is also eligible for an annual bonus under the Labcorp Bonus Plan. Bonuses are payable based on corporate and/or business segment performance and are subject to individual performance modifiers.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan.Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan.Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. For more detailed information, please click here.

VOCÊ JÁ CONHECE A VETTA?

Na Vetta, acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação são essenciais para criar um futuro mais sustentável e eficiente para todos. Como uma empresa líder em digitalização industrial, nossas soluções estão ajudando clientes em todo o mundo a reduzir o consumo de energia, a melhorar a eficiência operacional e apoiar a transição energética através da descarbonização.

Além disso, você fará parte de uma equipe dedicada em gerar um impacto positivo no mundo e em ajudar nossos clientes a alcançar seus objetivos de negócios. Experiência na construção de ferramentas para monitoramento e detecção de fraudes, utilizando técnicas de modelagem estatística, mineração e tratamento de dados, data scraping, análise exploratória, inteligência de negócios e visualização de dados. data.title: Senior SQL Developer
data.description:
Senior SQL Developer
Finance Data & Systems Migration
Full-time / Remote

About the role

We are looking for a Senior SQL Developer to be a part of PROVE Partner's parent company Allira’s team (remote). We are making SQL the single source of truth for all of our data. Every report, reconciliation and financial statement will run from SQL, while Salesforce and Pulse remain our working systems and feed SQL, until better systems are identified. You will be the hands-on technical owner of the SQL platform. You will also scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs, build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, and manage the project day to day, working closely with Finance, Operations and our Salesforce team.

What you'll do

  • Scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs: data mapping, sequencing, effort, risks and cutover approach
  • Design and build the SQL data model: staging, cleansed core tables and reporting marts
  • Build and schedule data loads from Salesforce, Pulse, the general ledger, loans and the loan ledger, and other sources
  • Rebuild our Salesforce reports in SQL, including accruals, repayments, settlements, clearing reports and weekly journal entries
  • Write tie-out logic that reconciles SQL to the general ledger on every load and every close
  • Turn manual exception reports into automated data-quality checks and alerts
  • Produce credit facility, lender and investor reporting by entity and funding vehicle
  • Build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, with clear system-of-record and reconciliation rules
  • Manage the project: plan, timeline, status reporting, risks and coordination with Finance, Operations and the Salesforce team
  • Work with our Salesforce team on data mapping and on changes that affect SQL
  • Tune performance, manage code in source control, and document everything you build
  • Partner with the Controller and accounting team during month-end close

What you bring

  • Completed at least one project of similar scope from start to finish, such as a Salesforce-to-SQL migration that included reporting and finance close
  • Hands-on two-way integration experience: writing data from SQL to Salesforce and other systems (Salesforce APIs, Bulk API or middleware)
  • Project management skills: scoping, planning, running timelines and status, managing risks and stakeholders
  • 5+ years writing production SQL (T-SQL / SQL Server preferred): stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and query tuning
  • Experience building ETL / ELT pipelines (SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Fivetran or similar)
  • Dimensional modeling: fact and dimension tables, history tracking
  • Hands-on experience extracting and modeling Salesforce data
  • Strong understanding of accounting data: journal entries, accruals, trial balance, subledger-to-GL reconciliation
  • Experience supporting a financial close or building finance reporting
  • Clear communicator who can work directly with accountants and operations staff

Nice to have

  • Specialty finance, lending or asset management experience (advances, receivables, payoffs, fee accruals)
  • Credit facility, borrowing-base or static pool reporting
  • Power BI or SSRS report development
  • Salesforce administration or development experience
  • Git, CI/CD for database deployments
  • Project management certification (PMP or similar)

Why join

You'll build the data platform from the ground up and own it, with direct visibility to Finance leadership and a clear impact on how the firm closes its books.
